name: Var-Shaa
description: Var-Shaa was a resource-rich planet located in the Mid Rim that hosted a dockyard of the Galactic Empire in its orbit. The dockyard was a key waypoint for the Imperial Navy, but was destroyed in a New Republic attack shortly after the Battle of Endor. The Imperial pilot Varko Grey, leader of Titan Squadron, was left behind when the Star Destroyer Overseer fled the battle, but was later rescued after he outmaneuvered a New Republic pilot that pursued him.
